quant.name: fp8_dynamic+mxfp4_experts
notes: ordinary linears use FP8 weights with the declared block scales; routed experts use FP4 group32 with E8M0 scales
activation_scheme=dynamic is a kernel path, not a global model dtype

default_mechanisms.basis: analytic resource programs; no measured dispatch or latency fit
default_mechanisms.gqa_kv_splits: default 1; explicit flash_attention_decode recipe may override
default_mechanisms.selection_boundary: family default; per-operator recipes retain priority
default_mechanisms.indexed_scratch: offchip; no inferred cache hit rate
default_mechanisms.sharedkv: SCFA source currently requires explicit prefill declarations
